name: breadcrumbs
description: Breadcrumb navigation showing the page hierarchy. Conditional: enabled via config or front-matter. Renders only on non-home pages. CSS uses .mdf-breadcrumbs classes.

params.description: Enable breadcrumbs globally for all non-home pages
params.effect: Shows breadcrumb nav on all pages (can be overridden per-page)

params.description: Override global breadcrumbs setting per-page. Set false to hide on specific pages.
params.effect: Hides breadcrumbs on this specific page even if globally enabled

config.placement: Call at top of single.html 'define main', or via {{ block "slot-before-main" }}

css.note: No standalone CSS. Style .mdf-breadcrumbs, .mdf-breadcrumbs__item, .mdf-breadcrumbs__separator, .mdf-breadcrumbs__current in main.css

partials.note: Override to customize breadcrumb HTML structure or activation logic
